title: Contextual Ops Fastpath and Dryrun Telemetry Gateway
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Support engineers currently switch between console, docs, and ad-hoc shells to run remediation steps. This causes context switching, accidental live runs, and poor telemetry for dryruns. Goal: Build a lightweight gateway that: 1) accepts 'fastpath' invocations (single-step or snippet bundles), 2) executes safe dryruns (synthetic or read-only simulation) against a shadow environment, 3) captures structured telemetry and QA signals, and 4) surfaces execution suggestions and risk scores in the Console and runbooks UI. The gateway should integrate with runbooks-as-tasks primitives and enforce permissioned canaries and idempotency checks.
acceptance_criteria: Fastpath API: POST /fastpath with snippet bundle runs a dryrun and returns a structured report within 4s for typical snippets
Dryrun safety: Dryruns must not mutate production resources (validated via mutation detectors and sandbox policy)
Telemetry: Dryrun events emit standardized events to telemetry pipeline with keys: fastpath.request_id, snippet.hash, simulation.result, risk_score
Console integration: Dryrun report visible inline on runbook step and in Ops Console history with link to original snippet
Permissioning: Role-based gating for live vs dryrun execution with automatic fallback to dryrun when permission absent
implementation_plan: Design gateway prototype and dryrun contract (2d) - link to spec
Implement a thin HTTP gateway that orchestrates snippet simulation workers (5d)
Add mutation-detection middleware and idempotency verifier (3d)
Integrate telemetry events and create dashboard (3d)
Wire Console UI to display reports and add 'approve to run' flow (4d)
E2E tests against staging shadow env and rollback plan (2d)
blockers: Shadow environment quota for simulation workers (infra ticket ENG-701002)
KMS access required for masked parameter evaluation in dryruns (security review pending)
